record.title: Farm Bill clock · 210 days
record.body: Hemp-derived THC window keeps narrowing. States are already moving — twelve have banned intoxicating hemp outright in the last six months. The brands that built on the loophole have a two-quarter runway to pivot to Rec-legal D9 or the federal medical program. Most won't make it.
record.author: cc
